Fetches Red Hat OVAL (Open Vulnerability and Assessment Language) vulnerability data for specified RHEL versions and stores it in the local database.

## Key Components

- **`fetchRedHatCmd`** — Cobra subcommand registered under `fetch redhat`, accepts one or more RHEL version numbers as arguments
- **`fetchRedHat()`** — Core handler that orchestrates fetching, parsing, and persisting Red Hat OVAL XML data

### Processing Flow

1. Initializes logger and opens the DB connection
2. Validates schema version via `FetchMeta` to prevent stale-schema inserts
3. Calls `fetcher.FetchFiles()` with deduplicated version args
4. Unmarshals each OVAL XML response into `redhat.Root` structs
5. Warns if any OVAL feed has not been updated within 3 days
6. Orders parsed roots by canonical RHEL file name pattern and converts them to the shared `models.Root` format via `redhat.ConvertToModel()`
7. Inserts definitions into the DB and updates `LastFetchedAt` in `FetchMeta`

### OVAL File Sources (per version)

| File Pattern | Description |
|---|---|
| `rhel-{v}-including-unpatched.oval.xml.bz2` | Main unpatched definitions |
| `rhel-{v}-extras-including-unpatched.oval.xml.bz2` | Extras channel |
| `rhel-{v}-supplementary.oval.xml.bz2` | Supplementary channel |
| `rhel-{v}-els.oval.xml.bz2` | Extended Life-cycle Support |
| `com.redhat.rhsa-RHEL{v}.xml` | RHSA advisories |
| `com.redhat.rhsa-RHEL{v}-ELS.xml` | RHSA ELS advisories |

## Usage Example

```bash
# Fetch OVAL data for RHEL 8 and 9
goval-dictionary fetch redhat 8 9

# With debug SQL logging and JSON log output
goval-dictionary fetch redhat 8 \
  --debug-sql \
  --log-json \
  --dbtype sqlite3 \
  --dbpath /var/lib/goval-dictionary/oval.sqlite3
```
